pins.name: rmsedge
pins.pattern: edge of the field: RMS (\S+) waves

caption: RMS wavefront error (log scale) and distortion against field for the SK16 / F4 / SK16 Cooke triplet at f = 100 mm, f/5: the thick seed from the textbook thin-lens solve, and the lens after the alternating CALIB rounds (`triplet_field.png`).
number: From the textbook thin-lens seed, the alternating CALIB rounds take the merit (the RMS over 0, 14 and 20 degrees) from %pin:p2_triplet_m0% to %pin:p2_triplet_m1% waves; at the 20-degree edge the RMS is %pin:p2_triplet_rmsedge% waves and the distortion, reported and never fitted, is %pin:p2_triplet_distedge% %.
prompt: Using templates/35_lenses/triplet, design a Cooke triplet for f = 50 mm at f/4 over +/-25 degrees in N-SK4 / SF2, and tell me the field curve, the distortion at the edge and which CALIB rounds were accepted.
